raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The stale-event filter added on 2026-01-17 (DE-412), `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR`, drops valid POSTED transactions. The source routinely delivers transactions up to about 3 days after they occur: for example, txn 902760 occurred 2026-01-13 06:01 and was ingested 2026-01-16 02:00. txn_id is unique across all 4814 rows, so these dropped rows are late arrivals, not duplicates or replays. Because silver is fully rebuilt from raw on each run, roughly 25% of rows in every batch from 3 onward are lost.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
